The Federal Open Market Committee approved the following statement for release by a 12 – 0 vote:
The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent.
Economic activity is expanding at a solid pace.
Inflation remains elevated.

The Federal Open Market Committee approved the following statement for release by a 10 – 2 vote:
The Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3-3/4 to 4 percent.
Voting against the monetary policy action were Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack, who preferred to raise the target range by 1/4 percentage point.
Economic activity is expanding at a strong pace.
Inflation remains elevated.
